turns.assessment: The abrupt, simultaneous loss of all channels is localized by AMP_INPUT_LOS and OSC_LOS to the first S14→S04 span, with matching loss on the reverse-direction final span. The same-time losses on S14–S20 and channels toward S15 indicate a likely multi-cable duct excavation near S14, which is characteristic of a fibre cut rather than an amplifier, connector, client-port, or channel-specific failure. For svc327, the relevant cut is the physical S14–S04 cable segment represented by E23 (and its reverse fibre E14).

proposals.rationale: O126 reports OSC_LOS directly on E23 while the next amplifier reports input LOS; the reverse fibre on the same physical segment also loses OSC and light. Abrupt bilateral loss, plus simultaneous losses on other cables leaving S14, strongly indicates a shared-duct fibre cut.
A sufficiently large added span loss could lose both payload and OSC, but the hard simultaneous bilateral and multi-route outage is much more typical of a physical cut.
